summary: b is the reduction of the components of Nz at P.

steps.claim: The witness b is left to unification (it is fixed in 1.2); fix y ∈ (ℤ/N)^P.
steps.lean:
⟨_, fun y ↦ (iff_and_self.2 fun a ↦ by simpa [mul_sub,
  mul_div_cancel₀] using (add_mem (nsmul_mem (evalPlaces_mem_O _ a) N) (mem_O_locProd.2 fun w ↦
  _root_.natCast_mem (LocInt _) (y w).val))).trans
  (and_congr_right fun H ↦ (reduction_eq_iff_idem_mul_mem
  (@Function.invFun_eq _ _ ⟨0⟩ _ _ (by simp_all))).symm)⟩

steps.claim: If idem(P)(z − y/N) ∈ Ô, then idem(P)(Nz) = N·idem(P)(z − y/N) + idem(P)·ỹ ∈ Ô; so the left side is equivalent to [idem(P)Nz ∈ Ô and idem(P)(z − y/N) ∈ Ô].
steps.lean:
(iff_and_self.2 fun a ↦ by simpa [mul_sub,
  mul_div_cancel₀] using (add_mem (nsmul_mem (evalPlaces_mem_O _ a) N) (mem_O_locProd.2 fun w ↦
  _root_.natCast_mem (LocInt _) (y w).val))).trans

steps.claim: Given idem(P)Nz ∈ Ô, let x ∈ O be the components of Nz at P and b = reduction(x) (the witness); then idem(P)(z − y/N) ∈ Ô ⟺ reduction(x) = y ⟺ b = y (reduction_eq_iff_idem_mul_mem).
